title: Blob/convert thumbnail note is orphaned — expand or delete
description: The last paragraph of Section 5 mentions JMAP-BLOBEXT and Blob/convert for thumbnail generation. It introduces an informative reference for one vague sentence and reads like scaffolding for a feature that is not defined. Either expand it into a real sub-section defining the thumbnail/preview pattern, or delete it and the JMAP-BLOBEXT informative reference.
